title: Tower Defense Make With IA
author: gordaneli
selftext:
Hey everyone! Hope you’re all doing well.

I’ve been working on a project called **Battlestar Popnime**. It’s a Tower Defense game mixed with Gacha mechanics. In it, you summon characters inspired by famous anime, level them up, increase their rarity, and build your dream team to clear various worlds, stages, and events. It features a Pity system, support elements, and a progression style that fans of the genre will find very familiar.

I want to be completely transparent with you guys: this project was made through a cool collaboration between human direction and heavy AI usage to speed up the codebase and design process. Specifically, I used Antgravity for manual coding/commits and Claude for fixes and refactoring. It was a massive challenge to tie everything together and polish the UI to get that right "vibe," but I want to be upfront that AI played a significant role in this project.

I perfectly understand those who aren’t fans of AI-assisted development, but it was thanks to these tools that I was able to bring this game to life—a dream of mine after years of playing similar games on Roblox.

I would be incredibly grateful if anyone from the community could give it a try and test it out. Since I’m still polishing things, I’m looking for any feedback on bugs, weird UI glitches, or balancing issues you might find.

*(Note: Audio isn’t 100% complete yet, and character/enemy balancing is still a work in progress.)*

[https://viniciusdevb.github.io/Battlestar-Popnime/](https://viniciusdevb.github.io/Battlestar-Popnime/)
